text: 11月11日从国家税务总局获悉，目前，离岸信托收益征税政策过渡期已平稳结束，绝大多数纳税人积极配合，累计申报离岸信托个人所得税超1600亿元，其中10月当月入库超1200亿元，带动了全国10月份个人所得税收入增长近90%。（新华社）
text_en: On November 11, the State Taxation Administration said that the transition period for the tax policy on offshore trust income has now ended smoothly, with the vast majority of taxpayers actively cooperating, and a cumulative total of over 160 billion yuan in individual income tax on offshore trust income declared, of which more than 120 billion yuan was collected in October alone, driving a nearly 90% increase in national individual income tax revenue in October. (Xinhua News Agency)
